name: South Korea Pavilion
summary: South Korea has contracted its Expo 2027 Belgrade pavilion: KOTRA signed the Korea Pavilion contract with exhibition builder Sigong Tech on 23 June 2026, worth 8,836,190,000 KRW (roughly €5.5 million) and running to 30 November 2027. The theme and design are not yet public.

about: South Korea's presence at Expo 2027 Belgrade is run by KOTRA (Korea Trade-Investment Promotion Agency), the state trade body whose World Expo team tendered the "2027 Belgrade Expo Korean Pavilion Exhibition Service" in spring 2026, per the Korean Architects Association (KIA) notice. The tendered budget was 9,000,000,000 KRW, covering a comprehensive exhibition-service scope: architectural design, interior construction, video production and industrial design. Bids were due 29 April 2026 through Korea's Nara Market e-procurement portal, and the winner was chosen by negotiated bid rather than lowest price.

The contract went to Sigong Tech, the Seongnam-based exhibition and museum builder. In a stock-exchange disclosure reported on 24 June 2026, Sigong Tech said it had signed the "2027 Belgrade Expo Korea Pavilion" supply contract with KOTRA for 8,836,190,000 KRW — about 5.2% of its recent annual revenue — with a term from 23 June 2026 to 30 November 2027. The same company separately holds the organiser's contract for the Expo's collective pavilions, the buildings that house every participating country without its own structure (awarded 31 July 2026), so one Korean firm is building both the Korea Pavilion and the shared halls around it. The pavilion's theme and design have not been made public yet.

faqs.question: Who is building South Korea's pavilion at Expo 2027 Belgrade?
faqs.answer: Sigong Tech, a Korean exhibition and museum builder. It signed the Korea Pavilion contract with KOTRA (Korea Trade-Investment Promotion Agency), which runs Korea's participation, in June 2026.

faqs.question: What is the budget for South Korea's Expo 2027 pavilion?
faqs.answer: The contract is worth 8,836,190,000 KRW, roughly €5.5 million, against a tendered budget of 9,000,000,000 KRW. It runs from 23 June 2026 to 30 November 2027.

faqs.question: What will South Korea's pavilion look like or be themed around?
faqs.answer: Not yet public. The contract covers design, exhibition content, installation, operation and dismantling, but neither KOTRA nor Sigong Tech has published the theme or design.
